51551397.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human Avi-tagged wild type STING (149 to 379 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 DE3 assessed as dissociation constant by Surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.Surface Plasmon Resonance: For the determination of binding affinity and kinetics, we used construct wt-hSTING (avi-149–379). Biotinylated protein was immobilized on SA chip (GE Healthcare). Interactions were monitored in a Biacore T200 system (GE Healthcare) in an assay buffer containing 30 mM TRIS pH 7.5; 50 mM NaCl; 1 mM DTT; 0.005% Tween-20; 2% DMSO. Compound concentrations between 0.1 and 100 nM were used. Data were evaluated with the Biacore T200 Control Software Version 2.0.1 (2010–2013). Reported affinity data are averages of 3 independent SPR experiments.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 30 mM TRIS pH 7.5; 50 mM NaCl; 1 mM DTT; 0.005% Tween-20; 2% DMSO
